Heard learned counsel for applicants, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and learned counsel for the informant and perused the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Special Case No. 704 of 2021 (State Vs. Jan Mohammad and others) arising out of Case Case Crime No.19 of 2021, under Sections 363, 366, 376 of I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station-Khatauli, District Muzaffarnagar pending in the Court of Special Additional Session Judge (POCSO Act), Muzaffarnagar as well as summoning order dated 19.09.2023 passed in the aforesaid case crime.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: During course of trial her statement was recorded and she again stated about the role of the applicant after one and half year.
The applicant is the brother in law of main accused Jah Mohammad.
It is further submitted that there is no evidence of involvement of applicant in the crime.
No case is made out against the applicants.
It is submitted that order impugned is perversed and suffers from manifesto error of law.
Learned Magistrate without applying his mind summoned the accused for facing the trial.
Per-contra, learned AGA assisted by learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer and submitted that the role of the applicant is mentioned in the FIR.

The victim during her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., during her statement given before the Doctor and also in her testimony before the Court has disclosed the name and role of the present applicant.
As per High School Certificate the victim is minor.
It is further submitted that the cognizance order has been passed after considering the evidence available on record, therefore, the present application deserves to be dismissed.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and after going through the available record, the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings of aforesaid case, cognizance/summoning order dated 19.09.2023 is refused.
Application is dismissed, accordingly.
